name: Agent Seat Class
description: The lifecycle-control relationship for one addressed agent session in a declared context, not a property of a harness product or physical machine. A seat has tool use and session continuity. Classification describes the relationship; it does not establish authority or consent.

values.label: Unknown
values.description: The lifecycle-control relationship has not been established.

values.label: Live seat
values.description: An operator-controlled interactive session participating through a cooperative mechanism, without delegating its native lifecycle to the connecting host. An unattended terminal remains live.

values.label: Headless seat
values.description: A session whose native lifecycle is managed by the owning host under an explicit delegation. An optional attached user interface does not itself transfer that ownership.

values.label: Hosted agent
values.description: A session whose runtime lifecycle is managed by an external agent provider. Access through a provider API does not confer ownership of that runtime.

examples.dataset: interactive session participating through an opted-in waiter
host-supervised session on a rented cloud machine
provider-managed agent reached through a provider trigger
